name: Riva del Po (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Riva del Po (a torch, a sun and a wheel above waves) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Riva del Po, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Riva del Po arms — torch, sun and wheel above waves, crowned, within branches
